item.title: Israeli paramedic delivers baby, rushes it to bomb shelter during Iran attack
item.summary: Israeli paramedic Dr. Gal Rosen delivered a baby in Tel Aviv, then raced to a bomb shelter with the newborn as Iron Dome missile sirens blared overhead.

item.title: Former Rep MTG vents that she's 'so beyond done,' characterizing Trump's address as 'WAR WAR WAR'
item.summary: Former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene said in a post on X that all she heard in President Donald Trump's Wednesday night address "was WAR WAR WAR."

item.title: Carville gloats that Democrats will go after Trump's 'stupid jack--- kids and their spouses' after midterms
item.summary: Democratic strategist James Carville warns Trump that Democrats will investigate him, his family, and their spouses after the midterms, predicting a sweeping GOP defeat.

item.title: Trump unleashes on Obama's 'disaster' Iran nuclear deal, says he was 'honored' to rip it apart
item.summary: President Trump said one of his biggest Iran achievements was terminating Barack Obama's 2015 nuclear deal, calling it a "disaster" that helped Iran get a nuclear weapon.

item.title: JONATHAN TURLEY: Justice Jackson's 'Chiles' dissent reveals narrow view of the First Amendment
item.summary: Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson issued a lone dissent in Chiles v. Salazar, warning free speech protections for counselors risk "grave harm" to Americans.

item.title: MORNING GLORY: President Trump’s big speech on Iran — what will it do?
item.summary: President Trump's address on Operation Epic Fury raised questions about NATO's future, Hugh Hewitt argues, as European allies failed to support the U.S.-Israel campaign against Iran.

item.title: What you need to know: 5 key takeaways from Trump’s Iran address
item.summary: President Trump addressed the nation Wednesday, saying the United States’ “core strategic objectives" in Iran are “nearing completion" — just a month after “Operation Epic Fury" began.

item.title: Fort Hood soldiers shift to underground training to prepare for battlefield medical care
item.summary: Fort Hood soldiers are training in underground tunnels to prepare for mass casualty scenarios, reflecting lessons learned from modern drone warfare.

item.title: 7-month-old baby killed by stray bullet in Brooklyn shooting, police say
item.summary: Seven-month-old Kaori Patterson-Moore was killed by a stray bullet in Brooklyn after a gunman on a moped opened fire on a crowded street, police say.

item.title: Yankees enter rare company as team stays dominant behind Cam Schlittler
item.summary: The New York Yankees have allowed the third-fewest runs to start an MLB season as the team defeated the Seattle Mariners on Wednesday night, 5-3.
